label: Everything depends for its being on itself
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, the non-strict existence-requirement reading of DependsForBeing (DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING): every x depends for its being on itself, that is, x would not be if x were not. On the bare counterfactual clause of DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING, apart from its agent-cause qualification, this is an instance of the counterfactual identity law (if A were the case, A would be the case), which holds in any selection semantics whose selected worlds satisfy the antecedent; the definition read whole, with its strict agent-cause paradigm, does not fix it, and it is not built into the primitive. It is incompatible with STMT-DEPENDENCE-FOR-BEING-ASYMMETRIC on any inhabited domain and compatible with STMT-DISTINCT-BEINGS-NOT-MUTUALLY-DEPENDENT. It is not a claim that anything explains or causes itself.
